results.name: Verification queue is office-only and rejects invalid filters
Focused file returns only the selected person, safe preview URL and opaque revision
Document review needs an explicit method, evidence and confirmation
Verification reuses the existing writer and records one attributable action
A document from another person cannot be reviewed using this file token
File changes reject a stale decision without losing the existing record
Expired evidence requires acknowledgement and cannot clear worker eligibility
Participant review does not infer funding or grant blanket approval
Correction requests retain evidence and explain the replacement needed
Requests are specific, validate dates and avoid duplicate messages
Reviewer ownership validates staff, survives reload and filters the queue
Screening and recruitment preserve their separate evidence and rules
Plan review is bound to the current confirmed version
Pagination reaches more than 30 people and closed files disappear
The frontend verification form reaches the real action and prevents double submission
All redesigned panels render with real API data and escape user content
Automation settings are office-only, validate all reviewers and reject stale settings
Automatic assignment respects availability, role, capacity and manual ownership
Recruitment remains office work and cannot be included in a person follow-up
Combined request needs approval, creates one message and rejects duplicate submissions
Follow-ups wait for delivery, remove completed items and escalate after the limit
Claiming a file is attributed, rejects another owner and overdue files are filterable
Stopping approved follow-ups cancels unsent messages and account closure prevents new reminders
Plan comparisons retain reviewed answers and show exact changes in a newer version
Legacy current reviewed plans do not acquire a false extra review requirement
Changes to a previously snapshotted plan are flagged even if its version was not incremented
Consented document suggestions remain separate from verification and detect changed evidence
Live queue refresh reports a changed file without replacing the review or draft
Cached queue rebuilds only changed people and invalidates on policy and day changes
Outbox rechecks remaining items immediately before transport and respects preferences
Worker uploads in all evidence categories reach the selected admin file with protected originals
A real module pass moves its completion record to Training without hiding uploaded certificates
Legacy records, misleading titles and uploaded copies survive module classification
Worker document panels group actual files, disclose missing copies and preselect requests
Training-only accounts explicitly show zero uploaded files and the missing document catalogue
Old queue projections refresh immediately to the separated worker document count
PDF uploads retain exact bytes and original protections; download is an attachment
Only the authenticated trusted viewer shell permits same-origin framing
All PDF rendering resources are local and served with usable content types
Viewer navigates PDF pages, zooms, rotates and exposes safe text without PDF scripting
Missing, denied, expired-session, invalid and password-protected PDFs show actionable errors
Worker and participant PDF panels embed the trusted viewer; images retain direct preview
Accepted HTML copies keep the accepted version and permissions; plan viewer is admin-only
HTML uses an opaque sandbox with a leading restrictive policy and no PDF controls
Compact PDF controls keep useful actions and show Retry only on failure
HTML documents and support plans open in the viewer without PDF instructions
